documents.text: Heman R. Goodrich House The Heman R. Goodrich House is a private residence located 428 South Church Street in Hudson in west Lenawee County, Michigan. It was designated as a Michigan Historic Site and added to the National Register of Historic Places on January 22, 1992. Built between 1861–1862, this house was built by Heman Goodrich, who was one of Hudson's first settlers in 1836.
